scenes.headline: How Leanstral proves theorems by acting like a coder
scenes.sub: Mistral's 119B, 6B-active model, a plain agent loop, and SafeVerify.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Currant! Leanstral proves math theorems in Lean, and it does it without any special prover machinery. Here's how.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: No prover scaffold. Leanstral proves theorems by running the ordinary code-agent loop, and scales by running that loop longer.
scenes.say: Top Lean systems wrap models in bespoke search machinery. Leanstral runs the ordinary code-agent loop instead, and scales by running it longer.

scenes.title: The loop is the whole method

steps.say: A theorem, or a repository with a missing proof, enters the same agent harness used for ordinary software work.
Leanstral edits files, runs shell commands, and asks the Lean language server for goals, types and errors.
It revises and keeps going until the proof checks. It's trained in this same loop, so there's no gap between training and use.

scenes.title: PutnamBench solved, by per-attempt token budget
scenes.say: More budget, more proofs: forty-four solved at fifty thousand tokens, four hundred and ninety-three at a million, five hundred and eighty-seven at four million.

scenes.title: Why it can't fake a proof

left.title: Reward: Lean stops complaining
left.say: Rewarding a model just for making Lean stop complaining invites cheating: leave a sorry, assume an extra axiom, loosen the checker.

right.title: Reward: SafeVerify passes
right.say: SafeVerify rejects all of that. Full reward needs a proof that compiles, uses only standard axioms, and takes no shortcut.

scenes.label: for 587 of 672 PutnamBench, against an estimated $300+ for Seed-Prover
scenes.say: And it's cheap: about four dollars a problem, edging a prover that costs an estimated three hundred dollars or more.

scenes.text: Train a plain code agent in the loop it's judged in, grade it with an uncheatable verifier, and run longer.
scenes.say: Train a plain code agent in the loop it's judged in, grade it with a verifier it can't cheat, and just run longer.

recap: An ordinary code-agent loop, no prover scaffold
More tokens per attempt, more proofs
scenes.say: To recap: a plain agent loop, scaling by budget, and a verifier that can't be gamed.
